name: Instagram
layout_summary: Left vertical sidebar houses primary navigation icons (Home, Search, Explore, Reels, Messages, Notifications, Create, Profile, More). The center feed displays vertical scrollable media posts with like/comment actions beneath each, while the right rail features suggested accounts.
avoid_traps: Instagram is installed as a native Windows desktop app from the Microsoft Store. ALWAYS launch and use the desktop app via open_application('instagram') — NEVER open Chrome or navigate to instagram.com!
When searching for a user in the Search drawer or Direct Messages, if multiple accounts match, verify with Mohamed or use the memorized handle (e.g. @omar.barakat.23) before sending.
Clicking Search expands a persistent left drawer rather than a new page; press Escape or click away to close it.
Clicking backdrop space around photo modals or dialogs dismisses them without saving drafts.

open_app.verify: Instagram desktop app window appears in foreground

search.primary: smart_click('Search icon in left navigation sidebar')
search.visual_fallback: smart_type('Search input in flyout panel', 'text', submit=true)
search.verify: Search drawer slides out from the left with an active input field

open_direct_messages.primary: smart_click('Messages icon in left navigation sidebar')
open_direct_messages.verify: Direct Messages inbox opens with conversation threads list

send_message.primary: smart_type('Message input box at bottom of conversation pane', message_text, submit=true)
send_message.visual_fallback: smart_click('Message input field at bottom') -> type_text(message_text, press_enter=true)
send_message.verify: Message appears at the bottom of the conversation thread
